beats.speech: Looking for synonyms for big? Here are ten. Each one comes with a picture, a meaning and an example. Let's start.

beats.label: five common synonyms
beats.speech: Part 1. Five common synonyms for big.

card.headline: Huge
card.example: We grew a huge pumpkin this year.

beats.speech: Huge. It means extremely big. We grew a huge pumpkin this year.

card.headline: Giant
card.example: The farmer won a prize for his giant pumpkin.

beats.speech: Giant. It means much bigger than normal. The farmer won a prize for his giant pumpkin.

card.headline: Enormous
card.example: An enormous mountain rose above the village.

beats.speech: Enormous. It means extremely large. An enormous mountain rose above the village.

card.headline: Massive
card.example: A massive rock blocked the road.

beats.speech: Massive. It means very large and heavy. A massive rock blocked the road.

card.headline: Vast
card.example: Sheep grazed in vast green fields.

beats.speech: Vast. It means extremely large in area. Sheep grazed in vast green fields.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: The desert is ___. You can walk for days.
card.answer: The desert is vast. You can walk for days.

beats.speech: Which word fits? The desert is blank. You can walk for days. Vast or tiny? | The desert is vast. You can walk for days.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: A ___ rock fell onto the road.
card.answer: A massive rock fell onto the road.

beats.speech: Which word fits? A blank rock fell onto the road. Massive or weary? | A massive rock fell onto the road.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
We grew a huge pumpkin this year.
The farmer won a prize for his giant pumpkin.
An enormous mountain rose above the village.
A massive rock blocked the road.
Sheep grazed in vast green fields.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | We grew a huge pumpkin this year. | The farmer won a prize for his giant pumpkin. | An enormous mountain rose above the village. | A massive rock blocked the road. | Sheep grazed in vast green fields.

beats.label: five more synonyms
beats.speech: Part 2. Five more synonyms for big.
Large. It means big. We ordered a large pizza. This one is a little more formal.

card.headline: Spacious
card.meaning: big, with a lot of room inside
card.example: Their new flat is bright and spacious.

beats.speech: Spacious. It means big, with a lot of room inside. Their new flat is bright and spacious.

card.headline: Gigantic
card.example: A gigantic wave hit the beach.

beats.speech: Gigantic. It means extremely big, like a giant. A gigantic wave hit the beach.

card.headline: Colossal
card.example: A colossal statue stood by the harbour.

beats.speech: Colossal. It means extremely big and impressive. A colossal statue stood by the harbour.

card.headline: Immense
card.meaning: so big that it is hard to measure
card.example: An immense crowd filled the square.

beats.speech: Immense. It means so big that it is hard to measure. An immense crowd filled the square.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: Their new flat is bright and ___. There is room for everyone.
card.answer: Their new flat is bright and spacious. There is room for everyone.

beats.speech: Which word fits? Their new flat is bright and blank. There is room for everyone. Spacious or weary? | Their new flat is bright and spacious. There is room for everyone.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: A ___ wave hit the beach and knocked us over.
card.answer: A gigantic wave hit the beach and knocked us over.

beats.speech: Which word fits? A blank wave hit the beach and knocked us over. Gigantic or tiny? | A gigantic wave hit the beach and knocked us over.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
We ordered a large pizza.
Their new flat is bright and spacious.
A gigantic wave hit the beach.
A colossal statue stood by the harbour.
An immense crowd filled the square.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | We ordered a large pizza. | Their new flat is bright and spacious. | A gigantic wave hit the beach. | A colossal statue stood by the harbour. | An immense crowd filled the square.

card.headline: Which word was new to you?

beats.speech: That's ten words. Which one was new to you? Write it in the comments, and try using it today.
